# sqlpipe v2.0

## API change

WARNING: Update clients that use `/v2/users` before you install sqlpipe v2.0. This release removes the `name` field from user responses. The endpoint now returns `first_name` and `last_name`. Clients that read `name` can fail after the update.

Replace each `name` reference with the applicable new field. Then do a test of each client.

## Incremental transfers

The new `--incremental` flag transfers only records that changed after the previous transfer. This option decreases transfer time and network use for repeated jobs.

Add `--incremental` to a sqlpipe command to use this function.

## Parquet performance

Parquet writes are 40% faster than in v1.x under the same test conditions. This change decreases the duration of jobs that write large Parquet data sets.
